oliver: heads up — after the canary roll at ~1945556600 we see a steady token/sec sag on continuous-batcher (ctb) for r4-small tests, ~25-30% drop :thinking:
maya: yup dashboards show it starting immediately after the kernel-selector change (PR #8421). latency p50 up slightly, p95 and tokens/sec hit worse.
samir: kicked off a perf-run and local profiling. attaching quick flame snippet, will post full later.
ci-bot: perf-run/387 completed: median tokens/sec -28% vs baseline, regression flag triggered.
oliver: here's the short perf capture I ran:
```
# perf top-ish summary (samples)
matmul_kernel (fp16_gemm_fallback)  -> memcpy_device  -> kernel_launch_overhead
nv_memcopy_async -> wait_event -> queue_drain
```
maya: hmm fp16_gemm_fallback shows up — might be falling back to slower kernel path at certain seq lengths. can we verify kernel hints mapping?
rachel: I looked at kernel selector logs in /var/log/rt/kernel_select.log: a change added a fallback for small batches that prefers fp16_gemm for quantized models. new heuristic misclassifies variable seq-length as "small_batch".
li: kv-cache numbers also look off: hit-rate dropped ~12% after the same deploy. that would inflate effective work per request.
samir: bisect started — narrowing to commits touching selector heuristics vs batching heuristics. initial bisect shows reverting commit 9c3f5a brings tokens/sec back to baseline on staging.
oliver: can someone repro with a deterministic replay job? use: `tools/replay_load --model r4-small --trace traces/seq-long.json --ctb-config configs/ctb/fast.json`
maya: running that now on a 4x gpu staging node. will post numbers.
ci-bot: note: the nightly perf CI also started failing post-PR merge, so it's not just canary users. threshold breach at 03:12 UTC.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T21:50:37 by maya -> canary, status: success
li: repro confirmed locally with replay — tokens/sec -30. added prints show selector chooses `fp16_gemm_fallback` when `avg_seq < 64 && kvcache_ratio < 0.65` — kvcache_ratio calc seems flaky with streaming warmup.
rachel: suggestion: revert the selector heuristic change (PR #8421) as a rollback blocker for rollout. we should instead fix the kvcache ratio calc and add unit tests simulating streaming warmup.
oliver: agree. set rollback hold on the canary and stop ramp. @maya can you open a revert PR and tag eng-runtime-pager?
maya: on it. creating revert PR now (will reference 9c3f5a).
samir: I'll post full perf flamegraphs and a short bash repro in the PR description (perf scripts + `nvprof` snapshots).
oliver: thanks. follow-up actions:
- hold rollout until revert lands and perf CI green
- add regression test: synthetic streaming workload to validate kvcache warmup and selector decisions
- add telemetry: log selected kernel + kvcache_ratio per route for 24h
maya: re: telemetry — I'll add a short-term debug flag to enable sampling across canary nodes.
ci-bot: queued perf-run/388 after revert PR created; will run baseline comparison once merged.
deploy-bot: rollback hold applied to rollout 2026-03-17T21:50:37 by oliver
oliver: great. thanks all — let's keep this thread for updates and paste the final revert PR link here when ready :+1:
